chassis.note: DSH_XCU00_EN rev 1.1 (05.07.2024): height 0.5U, width 19 in, depth 284 mm, powder painted steel. 22.2 is half of 44.45, the figure the sibling XAU sheet prints beside its own 0.5U. THE WIDTH IS NOT THE DATASHEET's: 19 in is the rack face with its ears. The body is drawn 431.35 wide, estimated - the five latch pillars stand on a 106.27 pitch centred on the rack face (centres 28.77, 135.03, 241.36, 347.63, 453.83 of 482.6) and the body is taken as the span of the row they bound, four pitches and one pillar. The ears reach about 25.6 either side of that.

drawer.note: THE WHOLE FRONT IS ONE PART. The front of the panel is the front of its drawer, so the front view is a single bay holding fibrain/xcu-drawer@1, which carries the four holder slots, pulls out its declared travel and stays captive. Its plan lands in the top view under the shell top, turned half a turn because a plan is drawn face-at-the-top and the top view has the rear at the top.

envelope-faces.note: rear, bottom, left and right are the envelope and are deliberately blank: no held image shows the rear, and the sides are plain sheet on the renders.

method.note: NO ORTHOGRAPHIC SOURCE EXISTS. Fibrain publishes a two-page datasheet with three overall figures and four three-quarter renders, and no drawing or installation guide (the site's media index was searched for both). The overall size is the datasheet's; everything across the face is measured off the one render with its camera on the centre line, which is of the 1U extendable sibling XHU00 (XHU00_6.jpg, 4000 px, the 482.6 rack face at 7.94 px/mm). The XCU's own renders (XCU00_1 to _4) show the same row - five red latches, four holders between them - and were used to confirm counts, not to measure. Modelling from renders was accepted at intake.

not-drawn.note: THE THREE PULL HANDLES ARE NOT ON THE FRONT VIEW. They hang from the top edge in front of the second, third and fourth pillars and dip across the adapters either side; seen square-on they cover parts of twelve ports and nothing fixes their outline. The rack ears are not drawn either: the library's ear is a 1U part. See `gaps`.
